items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. One valve at €52.
Section 7.1.9 covers the connection hose renewed with the fractured fitting. One hose at €27.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover labour on the fitting repair. Three invoiced hours at approximately €100 per hour.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used in the repair, but this generic charge does not identify them and comparable lines were not paid. Estimate €15 for one lot if documented as covered consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the plumbing repair. Use €83 for one attendance at the full rate because no monetary reduction is stated.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment brought in to locate the confirmed escape. One use at €17.60 is below the €2,500 gross event cap.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged after escaped water soaked it and froze; the external-frost endorsement is not needed. Estimate €160 for one localized repair operation, provided this line prices distinct work rather than duplicating the breakdown below.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of plaster loosened by the insured escape. Estimate €160 for one removal operation if separately charged without duplication.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers like-for-like rebuilding of the affected facade. One base-plaster line at €38.

Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the work to be identified and allocated to the affected area; the description does neither. Estimate €75 for one minor operation if substantiated as distinct covered work.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers re-forming the substrate on the water-damaged area. One substrate line at €31.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers the coats required to restore the pre-loss finish on the affected area. One four-coat line at €59.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary drying of the saturated wall before reinstatement. One drying charge at €254.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers primer needed to restore the damaged render finish. One priming charge at €117.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers labour on the affected facade area. Five invoiced hours at €55.40 per hour total €277.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude add-on fees, and this line identifies no distinct covered work. Estimate €40 for one charge only if shown to price covered work.
